title: EnvironmentProviderNode.v1
description: A node in the environment-provider graph: a concrete environment backend the spine MAY route a run to (e.g. a local-first golden-path environment, or a Repo2RLEnv/Harbor/OpenEnv-style environment held as a CANDIDATE). status moves candidate -> reference -> active under governance; a node is never born active. requires_docker / requires_network expose its capability needs so policy can keep deny-by-default (local_equivalent names the local-first fallback that runs without them). serves_truth is always false — the node measures agents, it does not produce served truth.

provider_id.description: unique id of this provider node

status.description: governance status; nodes start as candidate, NEVER active by default

requires_docker.description: true if this environment needs containers (gated; deny-by-default locally)

requires_network.description: true if this environment needs network (gated; deny-by-default locally)

local_equivalent.description: id/name of the local-first fallback environment that runs without docker/network, or null if none

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — an environment node measures agents/runtimes; it never serves truth
